Johanan_1: son of Kareah, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Kareah_1: father of Johanan, one of the captains of Judean forces (2 Kings 25:23)
Jaazaniah_1: son of the Maacathite, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Hoshaiah_2: father of Jezaniah [Jaazaniah_1] (Jeremiah 42:1) and a Maacathite (2 Kings 25:23, Jeremiah 40:8)
Jeremiah_6: the prophet (2 Chronicles 36:12), son of Hilkiah (Jeremiah 1:1)
